package main

import (

)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {

			AppName:                pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			ChannelInfo:            pulumi.String("web"),
			VerifyRank:             pulumi.String("1"),
			UserSetCapType:         pulumi.String("2"),
			DefendMode:             pulumi.String("block"),
			DisableInvisibleSwitch: pulumi.String("0"),
			VerifyDomain:           pulumi.String("example.com"),
			CheckAppidSwitch:       pulumi.Int(1),
			CheckIvSwitch:          pulumi.Int(1),
			CheckBoxStyle:          pulumi.String("2"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = captcha.NewIpWhiteListInternational(ctx, "example", &captcha.IpWhiteListInternationalArgs{
			Name:         pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			CaptchaAppid: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ApplyT(func(id pulumi.ID) (int, error) { return strconv.Atoi(string(id)) }).(pulumi.IntOutput),
			Ip:           pulumi.String("1.1.1.1"),
			Comment:      pulumi.String("remark."),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

## Import



Captcha ip white list international can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Captcha/ipWhiteListInternational:IpWhiteListInternational example 189910572#488584
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
